reels.title: How to make this viral cricket video
prompts:
Video prompt


VILLAGE CRICKET PULL SHOT – GOOGLE FLOW REFERENCE-VIDEO PROMPT
(Upload: @video1 = cricket_reference_10s_MUTED.mp4, @image1 = your photo. Works for boy or girl. 10s, 9:16)
DURATION: 10 seconds.
ASPECT RATIO: 9:16 vertical.
REFERENCE VIDEO (MASTER)
@video1 is the master reference. Recreate it exactly, frame by frame: the same camera position, camera angle, framing, camera distance, lens look, slow motion timing and the same continuous shot. Copy every movement exactly as in @video1: the active batting stance, the bat waggles, the tap of the bat on the pitch, the backlift, the ball arriving at waist/chest height, the pull shot and the bat swing path, the ball flying up into the sky, the slow-motion one-leg finishing pose, turning to the camera, hiding the face behind the bat, the smile and walking away. Same timing as @video1.
LOCATION: Keep the location exactly as in @video1 — the same dusty village cricket ground, the same cement pitch, the same three wooden stumps in the same place next to the batter, the same sky-blue building, the same trees and the same hazy evening sky. Do not change or add anything to the location.
IDENTITY
@image1 is the ONLY identity reference. Replace the person in @video1 with the person in @image1 — same face, gender, age, skin tone, body shape and hairstyle as @image1. Do not copy the original person’s face from @video1.
Clothes and shoes come from @image1 (same colours and style), identical in every frame. If the legs or shoes are not visible in @image1, use plain trousers matching the top and white sneakers.
Only one person in the video.
BAT AND BALL: Same bat and ball movement as @video1. Plain wooden bat with no stickers, no brand name, no text.
REALISM: Photorealistic real phone video, natural skin, natural motion, same lighting as @video1.
AUDIO: Preserve the original background music and its timing from @video1 if supported. Do not add dialogue, voice-over or unrelated sound effects. No lip-sync, no speaking.
STRICT RULES
– Do not invent new scenes, do not cut to close-ups, do not change the camera angle.
– No extra people. No text, captions, logos or watermarks.
– Keep 9:16 vertical.
FINAL RESULT: The exact same video as @video1, with only the person replaced by the person from @image1.

reels.title: How to make this viral attitude sapwa ai video
prompts:
AI Generator ke liye Prompt:
"A 3D animated, anthropomorphic green lizard character with a cool, confident, and slightly menacing attitude. He has a smug smile and is wearing stylish black sunglasses, a silver chain necklace with a crown pendant, a plain white t-shirt underneath an unbuttoned light grey casual shirt, black pants, and black beaded bracelets on his wrists. He is standing in the middle of a beautiful snowy mountain village at dusk. The background features cozy wooden cabins with warm glowing string lights (one cabin has a 'MOUNTAIN GOODS' sign), snow-covered pine trees, and grand snow-capped mountains. Snowflakes are gently falling in the air. He starts with his hands in his pockets, speaks with a calm but dangerous tone, gestures with one hand, and then turns around to walk away into the snowy street. Cinematic lighting, ultra-detailed, high-quality 3D animation style."

Video ke liye Dialogue (Voiceover ya Lip-sync ke liye):

"Main ladai jhagde se door rehta hu, to log sochte hain ki main darta hu... Dua karna, kabhi gusse me mulakat na ho."  

(Note: Video ke end mein jo skull wala animation pop up hota hai, wo usually video editing software mein as an overlay lagaya jata hai, isliye main prompt mein base character ki details hi rakhi hain).

reels.title: How to make kids mind world into reality
prompts:
AI image PROMPT — Funny Child Mind Animal Art
Create a funny, weird, innocent-looking animal drawing based on this animal name: [.            ].

The artwork must look like a young child (around 5–7 years old) has drawn it with colored pencils and crayons on plain white paper. Give the animal a hilariously weird body shape, oversized uneven eyes, a silly facial expression, a crooked smile, funny teeth, a tongue sticking out, thin awkward legs, tiny paws or feet, and exaggerated cartoon-like features. Add messy fur or feathers using rough, uneven pencil strokes. Use imperfect hand-drawn black outlines, random coloring outside the lines, visible pencil shading, childish proportions, and charmingly bad anatomy.

Make the animal look absurdly funny and unintentionally goofy, as if a child's imagination created the strangest animal ever. Keep the background plain white paper with a subtle paper texture. Full animal visible, centered composition, original handmade drawing aesthetic, simple 2D art, low-tech school drawing style, authentic childlike imperfections.

Important: It must look genuinely hand-drawn by a child, NOT like polished digital art, NOT 3D, NOT realistic photography, NOT professional cartoon art. No text, no watermark, no extra objects. High-resolution image.

MASTER IMAGE-TO-VIDEO PROMPT — FUNNY CHILD ART TO REAL WORLD

Use the uploaded drawing as the ONLY reference. Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 9:16 vertical video that transforms the exact funny child-made drawing into a living creature in the real world.

SCENE 1 — ORIGINAL DRAWING: Start by clearly showing the uploaded drawing on a plain sheet of paper. Preserve its original funny design, weird proportions, unusual body shape, facial expression, eyes, mouth, limbs, patterns, and every unique detail.

SCENE 2 — MAGICAL TRANSFORMATION: The drawn creature magically comes alive and emerges from the paper into the real world. Its hand-drawn shapes gradually transform into realistic skin, fur, feathers, scales, wings, or other natural textures according to the creature in the drawing. The transformation must feel seamless, creative, funny, and visually surprising.

SCENE 3 — REAL-WORLD CREATURE: Show the fully transformed creature in a photorealistic outdoor environment that naturally suits its appearance. It moves, walks, runs, flies, or behaves according to its anatomy. Preserve the drawing's original funny personality and recognizable features, even after becoming realistic. Use natural daylight, realistic shadows, detailed textures, believable physics, cinematic depth of field, and subtle handheld camera movement.

IMPORTANT: Automatically identify the creature and its anatomy from the uploaded drawing. Do not assume it is always a cat, dog, or any particular animal. Adapt the environment, materials, movement, and transformation to the specific drawing. The final creature must look like the exact drawing brought to life, not a generic animal.

VIDEO SETTINGS: Vertical 9:16, ultra-photorealistic, cinematic 4K look, smooth motion, consistent creature identity, realistic environmental lighting, engaging viral-video style.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: No cartoon rendering, no anime, no unrelated creature, no redesign, no extra limbs, no distorted anatomy, no flickering, no morphing into a different animal, no text, no subtitles, no watermark, no logos, no borders.

Video prompt 
"A pug dog standing on its hind legs wearing a colorful cloth wrap, dancing expressively and fastly in a sad, dramatic Bollywood style, perfectly synchronized to a melancholic Hindi song. reels.title: Make this viral profile clean ai video
prompts:
Image prompt :
Create an ultra-realistic, high-quality 9:16 vertical Instagram creator profile poster using the two uploaded reference images.

REFERENCE 1 — MY PERSONAL PHOTO: Use my exact face, hairstyle, skin tone, facial features, and identity. Preserve my natural appearance without beautification or facial changes.

REFERENCE 2 — MY INSTAGRAM PROFILE SCREENSHOT: Recreate my Instagram profile interface accurately, including my username, profile picture, bio, follower count, post count, following count, dashboard, profile buttons, and visible post thumbnails. Keep all profile details consistent with the uploaded screenshot. Do not invent new statistics or change my username.

COMPOSITION: Place my Instagram profile screenshot as the full-screen background, resembling a real Instagram profile page on a clean white interface. Position a realistic, full-body cutout of me standing confidently in the center foreground, overlapping the profile interface and post grid. My entire body should be visible from head to shoes, with natural proportions and realistic edges.

OUTFIT: A stylish blue-and-white color-block jacket, plain black T-shirt, relaxed-fit black jeans, and white sneakers. Hands inside pockets, relaxed confident posture, looking directly at the camera. Adapt the outfit to my reference photo if needed.

LIGHTING & QUALITY: Professional studio lighting, realistic skin texture, sharp facial details, natural shadows beneath my shoes, premium creator branding, crisp Instagram UI, photorealistic compositing, HDR, 4K quality.

IMPORTANT: Preserve my exact identity. Keep the Instagram screenshot recognizable and readable. Do not distort the face, hands, body proportions, profile layout, or thumbnails. No extra text, no watermark, no additional logos, no unnecessary objects. Make it look like a professionally edited creator profile poster, not an AI-generated collage.

reels.title: How to make this viral car effect
prompts: "First-person POV (Point of View), jisme ek vyakti ne black leather gloves pehne hue hain. Scene ek khule, flat safed desert (salt flat) me hai jiske upar saaf neela aasmaan hai. Aasmaan se car ke alag-alag parts tezi se niche ki taraf gir rahe hain. Vyakti achanak apne dono haath aage karta hai aur saare car ke parts hawa me hi freeze ho jaate hain. Phir vyakti apni mutthi band karta hai aur haath apni taraf kichta hai, jisse saare parts tezi se ek saath judkar ek sleek, silver futuristic car me assemble ho jaate hain. Aakhir me, vyakti ke haath me ek car ki chabi aati hai, wo button dabata hai, aur car ki headlights on ho jaati hain."
